watches.name: Wild ONE Skeleton X-Lite
watches.description: The Wild ONE Skeleton X-Lite is an innovative concept watch featuring a multi-material construction engineered for extreme performance. Its complex case architecture, composed of more than 30 components, integrates a highly shock-absorbing X-Lite casing ring and a high-performance mix of NORTEQ®, titanium and aluminum. Weighing just 45 grammes and paired with an ultra-light double-layered rubber strap, it delivers exceptional durability, comfort and resistance while maintaining remarkable lightness.

watches.name: Wild ONE Skeleton
watches.description: The Wild ONE Skeleton Titanium marks the first time NORQAIN's ultimate high-performance sports watch steps into a Grade 5 titanium top plate, introducing a new material dimension and a distinctive metallic character to the Wild ONE. Approximately 45% lighter than steel, titanium creates a striking contrast with the matte NORTEQ® and rubber elements. The NORQAIN logo, now integrated into the dial ring, offers an uninterrupted view of the new NORQAIN 4K Manufacture Calibre through the skeletonised dial.

watches.name: Wild ONE Meteorite Special Edition
watches.description: The Wild ONE Meteorite Titanium marks the first time NORQAIN's ultimate high-performance sports watch steps into a Grade 5 titanium top plate, introducing a new material dimension and a distinctive metallic character to the Wild ONE. Approximately 45% lighter than steel, titanium creates a striking contrast with the matte NORTEQ® and rubber elements. Completing the watch is a genuine meteorite dial, forged from an iron meteorite discovered in northern Sweden. Billions of years in the making, each dial is one of a kind, bringing a cosmic dimension to the Wild ONE collection.

watches.name: Freedom GMT Enjoy Life "Holiday" Limited Edition
watches.description: Freedom GMT Enjoy Life “Holiday” Limited Edition is your passport to the world. Inspired by the thrill of travel and the joy of discovering new places, this playful timepiece transforms the classic GMT complication into a celebration of life's greatest adventures. A colourful world map on the dial, playful holiday icons and a lifestyle-inspired GMT ring make it the perfect companion to explore the world. Limited to 500 pieces, one unique watch hides a Golden Ticket that will send its owner on a NORQAIN Escape for two at the luxurious Ayada Maldives Resort. Wherever you go, Enjoy Life.

watches.name: Adventure Chrono Swiss Football National Team Limited Edition
watches.description: The Adventure Chrono Swiss Football National Team Limited Edition brings the intensity of the game to the wrist. Developed in collaboration with the Swiss National Team and limited to 260 pieces, this chronograph combines bold design with mechanical precision. Its deep green “football field” dial, striking red accents, and sport-driven details reflect the energy of the pitch, while features such as the pulsometer scale and halftime indication connect the watch directly to the rhythm of the game. Built for performance and designed with the players, this timepiece captures the mindset of football—where every second counts. The watch is exclusively available on a stainless steel bracelet, while an additional red rubber strap is included in the watch box with every purchase, offering added versatility.

watches.name: Freedom Chrono Enjoy Life "Sprinkles"
watches.description: The Freedom Chrono Enjoy Life “Sprinkles” is a colourful celebration of joy and spontaneity. Inspired by the carefree sweetness of summer treats, this playful timepiece brings a burst of colour to the Freedom collection. Vibrant “sprinkles” across the dial and the uplifting “Enjoy Life” spirit capture the essence of living in the moment. Fun, fresh and full of personality, it’s a reminder to savour life’s little pleasures every day.

watches.name: Wild ONE Skeleton Chrono Limited Edition

A truly sporty and dynamic timepiece, the Wild ONE Chrono is built for action, shock-resistant, high-performance, and engineered to keep pace with intense competition and high-energy moments. watches.name: Freedom Chrono Limited Edition
watches.description: The Freedom Collection reimagines the Timeless Sports Chronograph with vintage style and modern sustainability. Designed for those who seek to disconnect, it creates space for the moments that truly matter, with friends, family, and the endless beauty of nature around the world.

watches.name: Adventure NEVEREST Limited Edition
watches.description: Built to explore, the Adventure collection captures NORQAIN’s all-terrain spirit with robust Swiss engineering designed for life on land and water. Featuring our signature mountain identity with a new mountain-inspired pattern strap, it balances functionality, endurance, and everyday wearability, ready for those who climb higher, dive deeper, and push further every day. 10% of the earnings from the sales of NEVEREST timepieces are donated to the Butterfly Help Project in Nepal helping families of sherpas who have lost their lives in the Himalayan mountains and give their children access to education.

watches.name: Adventure Chrono NHL Limited Edition
watches.description: The Adventure Chrono NHL Limited Edition captures the raw energy, speed, and precision of ice hockey. Created to celebrate NORQAIN’s partnership with the National Hockey League, this limited-edition timepiece unites the thrill of the game with high-quality Swiss watchmaking. Subtle yet playful hockey-inspired details pay tribute to the sport’s intensity and character. Just like hockey, this watch is driven by precision, resilience, and split-second timing, making it a powerful expression of performance both on and off the ice.

watches.name: Adventure Golden Hour Limited Edition
watches.description: Inspired by the fleeting beauty of sunset’s golden hour, the NORQAIN Adventure "Golden Hour" invites you to never stop chasing the light and to own every moment. Limited to 100 pieces and available only in the US and Canada.

watches.description: Inspired by the fleeting beauty of sunset’s golden hour, the NORQAIN Adventure Sport "Golden Hour" invites you to never stop chasing the light and to own every moment. Limited to 50 pieces and available only in the US and Canada.

watches.name: Wild ONE Meteorite Special Edition
watches.description: The Meteorite Special Edition is the first-ever timepiece to integrate genuine extraterrestrial material. Forged from an iron meteorite that journeyed across our solar system, pierced through Earth’s atmosphere, and was discovered in northern Sweden, each dial tells a story billions of years in the making. Crafted from our proprietary ultra-robust and ultra-light NORTEQ® carbon fibre composite, this bold creation is more than a high-performance watch: it represents a milestone for NORQAIN. By uniting cutting-edge engineering with a cosmic twist, the Wild ONE collection is elevated to unprecedented heights of craftsmanship and innovation.

watches.name: Freedom Chrono Enjoy Life "Ice Cream"
watches.description: The Freedom 60 Chrono 40mm Enjoy Life Special Edition – a scoop of summer on your wrist. Bursting with vibrant colours, this timepiece channels the carefree spirit of the season. Playful ice cream illustration and the uplifting “Enjoy Life” motto make it the perfect companion for sunny days. A joyful tribute to colour, fun, and freedom. NORQAIN Founder and CEO Ben Küffer said: " The “Enjoy Life” Special Edition is a tribute to the kid in all of us. That little ice cream in the date window is more than a playful detail; it’s a reminder to take life a little less seriously, enjoy the ride, and keep that playful spirit alive. Whether it brings back memories of your own childhood or reflects the laughter of your kids today, the “Enjoy Life” captures that pure, feel-good energy."
